title: 第12章 赏赐第13章 意外
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 剑山山腰，崖边亭台。
陆思言双腿交叠，慵懒的斜靠在栏杆上，她目光放远，眺望远处那座横陈在苍茫大地之上的巨大城池。
灰暗的天穹下，透过灰雾，能隐隐看到在那城池中央地带，有一片被光幕笼罩的山脉，山脉上宫殿星罗棋布，不时能望见有小黑点自光幕处飞进飞出。
那片山脉，赫然就是临江府的修行圣地，东漓学宫。
自开始管理家族事务之后，陆思言才知晓看似不大的家族，想要管理起来却并不容易，这时常令她身心俱疲，因此，每每有闲暇时光，她便喜欢到此来放松心情。
“陆师姐，原来你在这里呀。”
这时，一名身着素裙的年轻女子自远处走来。
陆思言抬眸望去，见是自己的好友，她顿时抬了抬手，“庄琴师妹，快过来。”
庄琴走入亭台，还未落座，就望见了桌上那盏变凉了的茶，她顿时调笑起来，挠着好友的小腰：“陆师姐，背着我偷偷和别人幽会呢。”
她这位师姐，喜欢钻研茶道，一般人可尝不到她亲自沏的茶。
“呀，别闹~”
陆思言笑得花枝乱颤，一个咕扭，抓住庄琴的手，连连求饶：“我的好师妹，你饶了师姐吧，哪有什么幽会，这是给宋师兄沏的茶。”
“宋师兄？”
庄琴闻言，顿时正了正脸色，宋子川虽为人和善，但却一心向道，威望很高，她不敢随意取笑，便好奇问道：“他来找你干什么？”
“还不是为了那资助。”陆思言将先前给宋子川沏的茶倒掉，又为庄琴添上一杯新的茶。
庄琴笑道：“可是给你推荐了什么好人选，有宋师兄亲自推荐，陆师姐距离中等家族怕是又近了一步。”
“哪有什么好人选。”
说到这个，陆思言语气中明显带起了几分不小的怨气，“宋师兄把我当冤大头了，一个二十岁才修炼到养气境后期，根本无望聚灵境的庸才他也推荐给我。”
庄琴一怔，问道：“所以你拒绝了？”
“那是自然，我陆思言不敢说能在修行一道有所建树，但在投资与识人这一点上，还是十分有眼光的。”
陆思言道：“虽说我陆家并不差这点，但也不能用来打水漂啊。”
不等庄琴说话，远处忽的有人急匆匆跑了过来。
“陆师姐，陆师姐，又有新弟子成功入门了！”
人未到，声已至。
来人是个年轻男子，是陆思言的资助者之一，资质不高不低，主要负责将观内的情报及时报告给她，如此一来，若是观内突然来了什么天才弟子，她也好第一时间前去投资拉拢人心。
陆思言与庄琴相视一眼，接着便急切的问道：“是谁？”
男弟子站在亭子外面，回道：“是个叫沈长青的男子，入门仅有两个月，关键是第一次突破就成功了。”
陆思言猛然怔住。
“沈长青？”
倒是庄琴有些疑惑，“师傅亲自指点的弟子里好像没这个人啊，按理说第一次就突破，资质应该不低吧……”
要知道，即便是十五岁突破至养气境后期的良才也不敢保证能在第一次就成功突破。
她正想着，突然注意到自己身旁好友似有异样，连忙问道：“陆师姐，你怎么了？”
陆思言没回答她，而是摆摆手让男弟子离开后，这才垂下眼眸，有些不自然的说道：“先前宋师兄给我推荐的人，正是这沈长青。”
“这……”庄琴猛然睁大眼睛，一时也不知说什么才好。
不过很快，陆思言便调整好了情绪，叹息一声，“没想到这小子的运气居然这么好，一次就突破了。”
庄琴拉起她的手，小心翼翼道：“陆师姐，要不咱们去示个好？毕竟他应该还没有得到资助，虽然不能雪中送炭，但锦上添花卖个人情也不错，而且能让宋师兄亲自举荐，说不定真有什么过人之处呢？”
content_en:
On the mountainside of Jianshan Mountain, there are pavilions and pavilions on the edge of the cliff.
Lu Siyan crossed her legs and leaned lazily on the railing. She looked far away, looking at the huge city in the distance that stretched across the vast land.
Under the gray sky, through the gray mist, one could vaguely see a mountain range shrouded in light curtains in the center of the city. Palaces were dotted on the mountains, and from time to time, small black dots could be seen flying in and out of the light curtains.
That mountain range is surprisingly the holy land of cultivation in Linjiang Mansion, Dongli Academy.
After starting to manage family affairs, Lu Siyan realized that it was not easy to manage a seemingly small family, which often made her physically and mentally exhausted. Therefore, whenever she had free time, she liked to come here to relax.
"Sister Lu, it turns out you are here."
At this time, a young woman wearing a plain skirt came from a distance.
Lu Siyan raised her eyes and saw that it was her friend. She immediately raised her hand and said, "Junior sister Zhuang Qin, come here quickly."
Zhuang Qin walked into the pavilion and before she sat down, she saw the cold tea on the table. She immediately started teasing and scratched her friend's waist: "Senior Sister Lu, you are secretly having a tryst with someone else behind my back."
As a senior sister, she likes to delve into the tea ceremony. Most people cannot taste the tea she brews herself.
"Yeah, don't make trouble~"
Lu Siyan laughed so hard that his branches trembled, and with a twist, he grabbed Zhuang Qin's hand and begged for mercy: "My good junior sister, please spare me, senior sister. There is no such thing as a tryst. This is tea brewed for senior brother Song."
"Senior Brother Song?"
When Zhuang Qin heard this, she immediately straightened her face. Although Song Zichuan was kind-hearted, he was dedicated to Taoism and had a high prestige. She didn't dare to make fun of him casually, so she asked curiously: "Why did he come to you?"
"It's not just for the funding." Lu Siyan poured out the tea he had made for Song Zichuan and added a new cup of tea for Zhuang Qin.
Zhuang Qin smiled and said: "But what good candidate have I recommended to you? With Senior Brother Song personally recommending it, Senior Sister Lu is probably one step closer to the middle-class family."
"There is no good candidate."
Speaking of this, Lu Siyan clearly had a lot of resentment in his tone, "Senior Brother Song took me for granted. He also recommended me to a mediocre person who only reached the late stage of Qi Nourishing Realm at the age of twenty and has no hope of gathering the Soul Realm."
Zhuang Qin was startled and asked, "So you refused?"
"That's natural. I, Lu Siyan, dare not say that I can achieve anything in my practice, but I am still very discerning when it comes to investing and knowing people."
Lu Siyan said: "Although my Lu family is not bad at this, it can't be used for idle purposes."
Before Zhuang Qin could say anything, someone hurried over from a distance.
"Senior Sister Lu, Senior Sister Lu, another new disciple has successfully started!"
Before the person arrives, the sound has already arrived.
The person who came was a young man, one of Lu Siyan's sponsors, with neither high nor low qualifications. He was mainly responsible for reporting the information in the temple to her in a timely manner. In this way, if any talented disciples suddenly came to the temple, she could immediately invest in winning people's hearts.
Lu Siyan and Zhuang Qin looked at each other, and then asked eagerly: "Who is it?"
The male disciple stood outside the pavilion and replied: "It's a man named Shen Changqing. He has only been started for two months. The key is to succeed in the first breakthrough."
Lu Siyan was suddenly startled.
"Shen Changqing?"
However, Zhuang Qin was a little confused, "It seems that there is no such person among the disciples taught by the master himself. It stands to reason that if he breaks through in the first time, his qualifications should be high..."
You know, even a talented person who has broken through to the late stage of Qi Yang realm at the age of fifteen cannot guarantee that he will be able to successfully break through on the first try.
Just as she was thinking about it, she suddenly noticed something strange about her friend next to her, and quickly asked: "Senior Sister Lu, what's wrong with you?"
Lu Siyan did not answer her, but waved his hand to let the male disciple leave. Then he lowered his eyes and said somewhat unnaturally: "The person that Senior Brother Song recommended to me earlier was none other than Shen Changqing."
"This..." Zhuang Qin suddenly opened his eyes wide and didn't know what to say for a moment.
But soon, Lu Siyan adjusted his mood and sighed, "I didn't expect this kid to be so lucky. He broke through in one go."
Zhuang Qin took her hand and said cautiously: "Senior Sister Lu, why don't we go and show our kindness? After all, he probably hasn't received any funding yet. Although he can't help in times of need, it's good to add personal favors to him, and if he can be recommended by Senior Brother Song himself, maybe he really has something special about him?"
